div.div: مَدْعُومٌ , applied to a leaning house or the like, that is about to crack, or fall down, Supported, or propped: differing from مَعْمُودٌ, which is applied to that which presses heavily, such as a roof; meaning “ held [up, or supported,] by columns. ” (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
